I.3.18–I.3.22 The space of directions, the tangent cone and its completion
contents.reason: No item of this pair uses directions or tangent cones; the local product charts of the cone/join theorem and the angular links of the spherical-simplex pair already supply the local geometry that this page consumes.

contents.name: I.3.24–I.3.28 Induced length metrics on local homeomorphisms and the complete-local-isometry covering criterion

I.7.39, I.7.55–I.7.59 Cone neighbourhoods of points, injectivity radius and systole of M_κ-polyhedral complexes

II.1.10–II.1.12 The CAT(κ) 4-point condition and its equivalence with CAT(κ) for complete spaces
contents.reason: The scaffold proves the comparison inequalities through the hinged and midpoint forms of II.1.9, which are enough for the globalisation, the tree example and the short-circle criterion; no item states or needs the 4-point condition.

II.4.9–II.4.11 Alexandrov's patchwork, the gluing lemma for triangles and the angle comparison for sweeps
II.4.12 Compact balls: a space of curvature ≤ κ is CAT(κ) iff pairs below D_κ are joined uniquely
II.4.15–II.4.17 Injectivity radius, systole, the minimum embedded circle and the finite-shapes case
II.5.1–II.5.5 Gromov's link condition for M_κ-polyhedral complexes and its local form
II.5.15–II.5.21 Flag, all-right and metric-flag complexes and Moussong's Lemma
contents.reason: The metric-flag criterion and Moussong's Lemma are the subject of the later large-spherical-metric-flags pair; this page supplies only the general cone/link criterion and the short-circle test that that pair will consume.

contents.name: II.6–II.9 Isometry groups of CAT(0) spaces, the boundary at infinity and visibility
contents.reason: The Coxeter group action on the Davis complex and its fixed-point theory are developed on davis-cat-zero-geometry-and-finite-subgroup-fixed-points; no item on this pair states a group action or boundary assertion.
